cases.setup: Inspect the created C08 Core facade.
cases.expected: Exactly execute, the dedicated recordToolCallResult Worker route, inspectRun, reconstructRun and snapshot are exposed.

cases.setup: Try to submit a Tool result through ordinary execute, then call the dedicated route with an untrusted Worker context.
cases.expected: Neither caller can record a Tool result or create state evidence.

cases.setup: Resolve shared product references and Tenant-specific data references, then try cross-Tenant, unfrozen, wrong-version and detached-resource tuples.
cases.expected: Only the exact frozen Tenant view resolves; URI syntax and another Tenant's data tuple cannot self-assert provenance.

cases.setup: Accept one C0 Mock effect, restart the file-backed Mock, replay it, then try forged, cross-Tenant and wrong-effect receipt lookups.
cases.expected: One durable immutable receipt is returned for the exact effect and every mismatched lookup fails closed.

cases.setup: Complete one Synthetic Run with input, model, prompt, skill, knowledge, one terminal ToolCall, C06 evidence and a result Artifact.
cases.expected: The terminal reconstruction contains the exact eight version/evidence categories and a stable reconstruction hash.

cases.setup: Inspect a RUNNING Run after its first ToolCall is prepared.
cases.expected: The authorized read returns Case/Thread state and version, exact input, Run version/state, the pending effect and its C06 policy without claiming terminal evidence.

cases.setup: Inject Tenant, Principal, Actor, policy, Adapter, enterprise endpoint or Connector fields into the request envelope or command.
cases.expected: Closed validation rejects before any dependency is called.

cases.setup: Fail C05 identity, C06 authorization or the final C03 admission in turn.
cases.expected: Processing fails closed in C05 to C06 to final C03 order and never reaches the C07-scoped Store after a failure.

cases.setup: Resolve Human A, obtain a real C06 decision bound to Human B, then resolve Human A again.
cases.expected: C08 rejects the C06 decision binding before final admission or storage.

cases.setup: Let another fully authorized Human try to prepare or finish a Run created by Human A, then inspect it through READ.
cases.expected: The second Human cannot mutate the Run; C06 READ may still expose the unchanged owner and state for governed manager oversight.

cases.setup: Restart the same Human under a new Session and Delegation, reauthorize, then continue the RUNNING Run.
cases.expected: Stable Human and workload identity plus security epochs retain ownership without binding recovery to an expired Session or Delegation.

cases.setup: Submit 32 concurrent copies of one exact command.
cases.expected: One state change, one Event, one Outbox record and one receipt commit; all other callers receive the exact replay.

cases.setup: Reuse one idempotency key for changed command content or a different resolved Human identity.
cases.expected: The reuse conflicts and cannot inherit the first command receipt.

cases.setup: Submit a stale Run version, stale ToolCall version or a receipt that cannot be verified against the stored Tool effect.
cases.expected: Neither Run nor ToolCall advances.

cases.setup: Prepare a second ToolCall while the first one on the Run is still PREPARED.
cases.expected: Core and PostgreSQL preserve exactly one in-flight ToolCall and do not advance the Run.

cases.setup: Create Artifact version 1, append version 2 on the same ID, then retry a stale version or change its lineage.
cases.expected: Versions remain append-only on one ID and stale or mismatched continuations fail closed.

cases.setup: Finish a FAILED Run with a result summary Artifact and no ToolCall.
cases.expected: The Run reconstructs with tools=[] and no fabricated Tool evidence.

cases.setup: Make the PostgreSQL Store return a stable public conflict code at the Core boundary.
cases.expected: The exact stable code is preserved while unknown backend failures remain normalized.

cases.setup: Finish or reconstruct a Run without a RESULT Artifact, with a nonterminal ToolCall, or mark SUCCEEDED without at least one successful ToolCall.
cases.expected: The Run cannot finish or reconstruct; FAILED and CANCELLED may omit ToolCalls only when the result summary exists.

cases.setup: Mutate caller-owned manifest and evidence objects after START_RUN returns.
cases.expected: Persisted Run references remain unchanged.

cases.setup: Alter one persisted Run reference after the terminal reconstruction hash is frozen.
cases.expected: Reconstruction fails closed with a hash mismatch.

cases.setup: Alter the persisted C06 authorization evidence for one ToolCall after the terminal reconstruction hash is frozen.
cases.expected: Tool authorization evidence is part of the reconstruction hash and the altered Run fails closed.

cases.setup: A Mock accepts one Tool effect and the Outbox Worker stops before acknowledging its lease.
cases.expected: The Store-only Worker seam reclaims the same Event and effectKey, the Mock deduplicates it and the stale lease cannot publish.

cases.setup: Run the real C08 Outbox Worker when a Publisher durably accepts an Event but its acknowledgement is lost, then restart the Worker and Publisher.
cases.expected: The Worker requeues, republishes the same Event ID, observes a duplicate acknowledgement and completes one durable effect.

cases.setup: Claim, fail, reclaim and complete Outbox records through both Memory and PostgreSQL Stores.
cases.expected: Both implementations return the same canonical fields and clear the prior error when a new lease is claimed.

cases.setup: Two Synthetic Tenants create state in the same memory Store.
cases.expected: Each control snapshot counts only its own Tenant records.

cases.setup: Call snapshot without an explicit control-plane authorization result.
cases.expected: The snapshot is denied before C07-scoped state is read.

cases.setup: Run C08 CREATE_CASE and reconstruct authorization through the real C06 Facade using catalog-fixed MANAGE and READ resources, then remove a required tuple.
cases.expected: The real C06 path authorizes in order; a missing tuple denies before C08 final admission or storage.

cases.setup: Inspect every C08 Tenant-scoped PostgreSQL record.
cases.expected: All eight records use ENABLE and FORCE RLS and the C07 runtime scope predicate.

cases.setup: Inspect Event, Outbox, receipt and aggregate version guards.
cases.expected: Atomic pairs, append-only evidence and immutable version transitions are enforced by the schema.

cases.setup: Inspect command transaction, scope and Store-only Outbox lease code.
cases.expected: Commands use serializable idempotency and Outbox Workers use fenced SKIP LOCKED leases.

cases.setup: Derive command effect keys repeatedly and change Tenant or idempotency key.
cases.expected: The same input is stable and either changed bound value produces a different key.

cases.setup: Inspect C08 runtime and Outbox Worker database roles.
cases.expected: Runtime roles are non-owner and NOBYPASSRLS; Case/Thread cannot UPDATE and no runtime role can DELETE or TRUNCATE.

cases.setup: Fail a reducer after partial state or omit the matching Event/Outbox/receipt pair.
cases.expected: The PostgreSQL transaction leaves no partial state or partial evidence.

cases.setup: Run 32 concurrent PostgreSQL retries for one command.
cases.expected: Exactly one durable effect and one exact replay receipt remain.

cases.setup: Replay the same committed command and idempotency key under a new correlation ID.
cases.expected: PostgreSQL returns the original receipt without invoking the reducer again.

cases.setup: Commit orphan or mismatched CommandReceipt, DomainEvent and Outbox combinations.
cases.expected: Deferred constraints reject every incomplete or inconsistent evidence set at COMMIT.

cases.setup: Lose the client acknowledgement after PostgreSQL commits, then retry the exact command.
cases.expected: The retry reads the durable receipt and does not repeat the state change.

cases.setup: Write the same logical IDs for three Synthetic Tenants.
cases.expected: Every directed read returns only the current C07-scoped Tenant state.

cases.setup: Under a valid Tenant A scope, probe Tenant B Artifact IDs that do and do not exist.
cases.expected: The invoker chain guard sees only Tenant A and both probes return the same RLS denial without an existence side channel.

cases.setup: Under a valid runtime scope, directly UPDATE an existing Case and Thread.
cases.expected: Both statements are denied because C08 exposes no Case or Thread update command.

cases.setup: Advance ToolCall, Run and same-ID Artifact chains by exact compare-and-set versions, then race or retry an old version.
cases.expected: Only the valid next transition commits and every stale transition is rejected.

cases.setup: Terminate the PostgreSQL Backend during a command transaction.
cases.expected: The partial attempt rolls back and the bounded retry commits one complete command.

cases.setup: Two Outbox Workers claim concurrently, one lease expires and a new Worker reclaims it.
cases.expected: Claims are disjoint, lease versions increase and the stale Worker cannot publish.

cases.setup: Let the PostgreSQL Outbox Worker deliver to a file-backed Mock, restart the Mock before acknowledgement, expire the lease and reclaim it.
cases.expected: The same effect key and durable receipt are reused, the restarted Mock deduplicates it and the stale Worker cannot publish.

cases.setup: Validate the five OpenAPI operations, the six employee command variants and the closed Tool-result Worker envelope.
cases.expected: The Worker route is separate from execute; Outbox claim/complete/fail remain absent from the Core API.

cases.setup: Validate START_RUN against run-manifest.v1.schema.json and reject tool, policy or result fields at start time.
cases.expected: Only inputArtifact, model, prompt, skill, knowledge and traceRef are accepted.
